newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp names MacMahon top executive.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp names MacMahon top executive.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America said Tuesday it had named Chairman Thomas MacMahon to the additional positions of president and chief executive.
In his new posts, MacMahon succeeds James Powell, who is leaving the company to pursue an entrepreneurial venture.
MacMahon, 50, assumes his responsibilities immediately, the company said. He has served as chairman since April 1996.
Powell will remain a LabCorp director and serve as a consultant to the company, the company said.
Laboratory Corp is a clinical laboratory operator.
